Removed 'Brazilian Portuguese' - while mentioned in abstract examples, the actual dataset and experiments are in English. Removed 'RoBERTa' as it's used for edit intention classification, not NLG. Normalized outputs for consistency.
Normalized metric variants to base forms (ROUGE-L → ROUGE) and removed duplicates (EG and FKGL were redundancies).
No LLMs were used as judges for evaluation in this paper.

Human annotators compare original and revised texts (or model vs. human revisions) and select which has better overall quality, judging across the criteria of content preservation, fluency, coherence, readability, and overall quality.
We randomly shuffle the original and revised texts, and ask the evaluators to select which one has better overall quality. They can choose one of the two texts, or neither.
